findings.description: The customer-managed KMS key does not enable automatic rotation (enable_key_rotation is not set to true), as the inline comment acknowledges. Without rotation, the key material is never renewed, so any long-term compromise of the key material remains effective indefinitely and the key falls short of CIS AWS control 3.7 for rotation of customer-managed CMKs.
